description: Governed MCP Tool Registry for Zerodha AI Financial Intelligence Platform

tools.name: lookup_portfolio
tools.description: Fetches normalized holdings, risk profile, and investment snapshot for a given portfolio ID.

tools.name: validate_portfolio_completeness
tools.description: Validates if portfolio holdings data has all required fields (symbol, shares, avg_buy_price, current_price) to compute accurate analytics.

tools.name: fetch_market_quotes
tools.description: Fetches real-time price, day high/low, and 52-week statistics for Indian stock symbols.

tools.name: fetch_historical_ohlc
tools.description: Fetches candlestick historical price series for a symbol over a requested timeframe.

tools.name: fetch_ticker_sentiment_news
tools.description: Retrieves recent news signals and sentiment headlines for a specific stock ticker.

tools.name: compute_portfolio_metrics
tools.description: Computes deterministic analytics including sector concentration, drawdown, volatility, stock contribution, and benchmark beta.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cached market data

tools.name: calculate_risk_alerts
tools.description: Evaluates sector concentration, drawdown thresholds, and volatility levels to generate governed risk warnings.

sector_allocation.description: Map of sector names to percentage weights
